locations.text: That's okay — we can still build a steady study rhythm and use your practice data to decide when you may be ready to schedule.
locations.assessment: BENIGN_UX — This is in the onboarding exam-scheduling conversational flow (non-coaching context). It refers to scheduling an exam, not predicting exam success. The word 'ready' here means 'ready to schedule' (logistical), not 'ready to pass.' No banned phrase triggered. This is an acceptable UX prompt.

locations.text: Consistency is the biggest predictor of progress — keep showing up.
locations.assessment: BENIGN_MOTIVATIONAL — Uses 'predictor' in the context of consistent practice predicting progress (not exam outcomes). This is a general learning-science statement, not an exam-outcome prediction. Phrased as a motivational fallback in S127 weekly digest. Not a banned phrase.

predictionLanguage.note: Banned phrases (exam ready, exam-ready, ready for the exam, guaranteed to pass, will pass, definitely pass, sure to pass) confirmed absent from all coaching output functions. The two flagged items are benign UX/motivational uses in non-coaching contexts.

readinessLanguage.note: 'Approaching review-ready' and 'Ready for focused review' are known vocabulary bands in _safetyVocab.knownBands — they are evidence-based descriptive labels, not predictions. Test S129-17 confirms effectiveness engine never contains readiness estimates. Readiness bands are surfaced through getReadinessSummary() with provenance disclosure.

causalLanguage.note: No causal claims found in recommendation output. S129 _generateStrategyEffectiveness() includes explicit anti-causation disclaimer at lines 3499-3501: 'No conclusion implies causation' and 'does NOT mean the recommendation caused the improvement.' S128 _generateStudyStrategy() includes: 'Every recommendation above is based on your actual practice data.' S113-08/S113-09 instability tests verify causal language is not used.

answerExposure.note: CorrectChoice access patterns verified: all uses are gated behind hint-level checks (level 4 for full reveal), review-mode gating, or answer-attempt preconditions. ensureSafeTutoringOutput() at line 5682 enforces: (a) no answer leakage in hint levels 0-3, (b) no exam-mode leakage. Tests C-08, C-09, E-03, E-04, E-07, F-04 all pass.

fabricatedTrends.note: No fabricated trends detected. S124-05 confirms _identifyLearningPatterns does not fabricate patterns from thin data. S120-07 confirms _inferCommonTrap does not fabricate facts. S121-11 confirms _inferWhyTempting does not fabricate. S122-07 confirms simplify coaching contains no fabrication on thin explanations.

unsupportedRecommendations.note: All recommendations are evidence-backed. S113 evidence validators (_hasImprovingEvidence, _hasPersistentWeakEvidence, _hasDecliningEvidence, _hasUnstableEvidence, _hasHintDependentEvidence) enforce minimum data thresholds before claims. S125-02 suppresses output when data insufficient. S128-01 returns null with zero sessions.

safetyMechanismVerification.S129_antiCausation_details: Lines 3499-3501 in _generateStrategyEffectiveness(): explicit dual disclaimer — 'No conclusion implies causation' and 'does NOT mean the recommendation caused the improvement.' Lines 3384-3385: function-level comment 'Never makes causal claims. Never uses prediction/readiness/confidence language.' Test S129-12 confirms anti-causation language present.
safetyMechanismVerification.S128_noReadiness_details: _generateStudyStrategy() returns null with zero sessions (line 3230: lookback.length < 1). No readiness estimates or exam-outcome predictions anywhere in strategy output. Strategy prioritizes weak topics based on observed accuracy only. Test S128-03 confirms no prediction language.
safetyMechanismVerification.S127_evidenceDisclosure_details: _generateWeeklyDigest() requires >= 2 sessions (line 3063). All claims tied to actual practice data: accuracy trends (delta computed from first vs. last session), topic breakdowns, misconception pattern counts. Returns null when totalAnswered === 0. Test S127-01 confirms insufficient-sessions null return. Test S127-05 confirms no prediction language.
safetyMechanismVerification.S126_zeroSuppression_details: _generateSessionRecap() returns null on: (a) null sessionObj (line 2942), (b) empty session (no answers), (c) allMcqAnswered === 0 (line 2955). Test S126-02 confirms null return for empty session. Test S126-03 confirms null return for null session object.
safetyMechanismVerification.S125_minThresholds_details: _suggestFocusAreas() enforces: >= 5 attempts AND < 60% accuracy for persistent-weakness suggestions (line 1396). >= 3 attempts AND >= 85% accuracy for strong-topic reinforcement (line 1445). Suppresses output entirely when no suggestions exist (test S125-02). Test S125-02 confirms data-insufficient suppression.
safetyMechanismVerification.S124_minAttempts_details: _identifyLearningPatterns() enforces minAttempts=3 (line 1248) before any observation is made. Topic-strength observations require >= 3 attempts AND >= 85% accuracy (line 1259). Misconception patterns require count >= 2 (line 1303). Test S124-04 confirms minimum data thresholds. Test S124-05 confirms no fabrication from thin data.
safetyMechanismVerification.S123_noAnswerLeak_details: _generateNextBestStep() categorizes errors (calculation, formula, computation_error, classification, concept_confusion, terminology, distractor_trap, oversight) without revealing the correct answer. For unanswered questions, returns non-revealing general guidance (line 1158-1163). Test S123-10 confirms no answer leak for unanswered. Test S123-05 confirms no prediction language.
safetyMechanismVerification.S120-S122_noPrediction_details: S120: _buildTutorExplanation() and _explainAnswer() — test S120-06 confirms no exam-prediction language. S121: _buildWrongChoiceCoaching() and _explainWrongChoices() — test S121-07 confirms no prediction language. S122: _buildSimplifyCoaching() and _simplifyExplanation() — test S122-08 confirms no prediction language. All three route through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode.
safetyMechanismVerification.modelVersion_details: Confirmed S111-1.0 in all 3 source locations: may-learner-state.js getReadinessSummary()._provenance.modelVersion (line 796), may-learner-state.js getSectionReadinessSummary().modelVersion (line 961), may-core.js exportMayPilotData (line 5849). All test assertion files (test_readiness.js, test_calibration.js, test_may_stagec.js) verify S111-1.0. No mismatches found.

findings: PRIORITY-HIGH: All 317 tests across 3 suites PASS — zero failures. Tutoring safety (178/178), Stage C (119/119), Governance Guard (20/20).
PRIORITY-HIGH: Zero safety violations in coaching output paths. All banned phrases absent. Evidence disclosure present in all output-construction functions S124-S129.
PRIORITY-HIGH: modelVersion S111-1.0 confirmed universally across all source files, test assertions, exports, and reports. No drift detected.

PRIORITY-HIGH: Anti-causation disclaimer verified in S129 effectiveness engine (lines 3499-3501). Dual disclaimer: 'No conclusion implies causation' + 'does NOT mean the recommendation caused the improvement.'

NOTE: Two benign 'ready'/'predictor' usages found in non-coaching contexts (onboarding UX line 368, motivational fallback line 3204). Neither triggers banned-phrase detection. Both are outside coaching-output paths.

NOTE: 'Approaching review-ready' and 'Ready for focused review' are known vocabulary bands — evidence-backed descriptive labels, not exam-outcome predictions. Listed in _safetyVocab.knownBands and surfaced via getReadinessSummary() with full provenance disclosure.
NOTE: S128 has the fewest subsystem tests (6) but still exceeds the minimum threshold of 5. S129 leads with 20 tests reflecting the complexity of the effectiveness analytics engine.

NOTE: Silent suppression verified — S126 returns null on empty/null session and zero-answered sessions. S125 suppresses when data insufficient. S127 returns null with <2 sessions. S128 returns null with zero sessions. S129 returns hasData=false with no recommendations.
NOTE: All coaching flows (S120-S122) route through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode per S111 wiring. Tests S120-10, S121-09, S122-09 confirm guarded-speak routing.
NOTE: Regression protection confirmed — each S123-S129 layer includes regression tests verifying S120-S122 explain/wrong-choices/simplify flows still function. Cross-layer regression tests all pass.

methodologyNotes.testExecutionEnvironment: Node.js on Windows, all 3 suites run sequentially in same process
methodologyNotes.mayCoreJsAuditScope: Full may-core.js (~6300 lines) grep-scanned for: predict, forecast, ready, pass the exam, guaranteed, will succeed, causal, because of, due to, CorrectChoice exposure, confidence/probability/score language, evidence disclosure
methodologyNotes.modelVersionVerification: Grep across entire project (*.js, *.json, *.md) for modelVersion string. All source locations and test assertions reviewed.
methodologyNotes.testCoverageMethodology: Counted by S12X prefix in test names from tutoring safety test output. Regression/overlap tests counted under their primary subsystem.
methodologyNotes.limitation: Grep-based scan may miss semantically equivalent phrases not matching exact search patterns. However, the test suites provide runtime validation that banned phrase detection works on actual output.
